feast.note: His name page lists one other day, «26 января (Новомуч.)», the synaxis of the new martyrs and confessors of the Russian Church. One row per church is the schema, so that day is recorded here and he does not render on it.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 2 декабря ст. ст. — «Мч. Бориса (1942)»

death.note: The year the day line closes with, and the only year this calendar gives him. He is the only saint on this day dated 1942 and the last of the day’s six twentieth-century clauses.

names.note: The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru’s name page 12986, «Борис (Успенский), мч.», with the grade word left off. The day line declines the forename and prints no surname. Four folders in this corpus carry the same surname with other forenames — `constantine-uspensky`, `john-uspensky`, `peter-uspensky` and `peter-presbyter-martyr-1930` — and none carries this forename with it.
